## Beautiful Text v1.2.0 for Minecraft 26.2

Fabric mod that automatically prefixes your chat messages with custom color/format codes.

### Install

1. Install Fabric Loader `0.19.0+` and Fabric API for Minecraft `26.2`.
2. Drop `beautiful-text-1.2.0+mc26.2.jar` into your `mods/` folder.
3. (Optional) Install Mod Menu to configure the prefix via GUI.

Cloth Config is bundled inside the jar — no separate download needed.

### Requirements

- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.0+**, Fabric API
- Java **25+**

## Beautiful Text v1.2.0 for Minecraft 1.17.1

Fabric mod that automatically prefixes your chat messages with custom color/format codes.

### Install

1. Install Fabric Loader `0.14.0+` for Minecraft `1.17.1`.
2. Drop `beautiful-text-1.2.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder.
3. (Optional) Install Mod Menu to configure the prefix via GUI.

### Requirements

- Minecraft **1.17.1**
- Fabric Loader `>= 0.14.0`
- Java `>= 16`
- Fabric API **not required** — Cloth Config is bundled into the jar.

### Notes

- Full rebrand from `text-krasiviy` to `beautiful-text` (mod id, asset folder, language keys, Java classes).
- All in-code comments stripped.
- Looking for the 1.21.4 build? See the [`mc-1.21.4`](https://github.com/Fix85/beautiful-text/releases/tag/v1.2.0-mc1.21.4) release.
